# Repository 1.3.0 — P2 Weekly Organic Report

P2 ships one transport-free read-only end-to-end workflow in `yandex-seo`: Weekly Organic Report. The release combines normalized Webmaster/Metrika evidence into portable deterministic artifacts without giving the cross-service plugin Yandex credentials or live-write authority.

## Weekly Organic Report

- `seo-weekly-organic-report/v1` is the normative machine-readable report contract with exact current/comparison periods, explicit source coverage, provenance, limitations, findings and delegated previews.
- `yandex-ai-artifact-manifest/v1` records the immutable artifact set, managed relative paths, media roles and SHA-256 hashes.
- `report.html` is a self-contained deterministic view of `report.json`: restrictive CSP, no CDN/remote fonts/analytics/network fetch, and escaped source/user text.
- Mermaid/DOT exports are generated only for source structures that actually exist; P2 never invents topology merely to populate diagrams.
- Existing artifact directories are immutable. Exact replay is accepted only when every managed byte/hash matches; a conflicting snapshot fails closed instead of overwriting history.
- Optional Project Memory input is read-only and limited to project identity plus active `USER_STATED` facts. Decisions, hypotheses, stale baselines and prior reports do not become fresh evidence or write authority.
- Delegated recommendations are explicitly `PREVIEW-ONLY`; P0 exact-preview/later-turn approval and bulk acknowledgement remain unchanged.

## Quick path

```bash
cd plugins/yandex-seo
python scripts/seo_weekly_report.py demo --output-root ./artifacts --generated-at 2026-09-06T12:30:00Z
```

The bundled demo is sanitized, offline, and uses the same normalization/rendering/artifact contracts as real builds.

## Release set

- Repository: `1.3.0` / tag `1.3.0`.
- Yandex SEO: `1.2.0` / tag `yandex-seo-v1.2.0`.
- Direct `2.1.0`, Metrika `2.1.0`, Webmaster `2.1.0`, Wordstat `1.1.2`, Search `1.0.2`, and Marketing `1.1.0` are unchanged and their historical tags/releases are not retargeted.
